text_block_list.name: Pisa & Ruler
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!
Taaaaaaaaaahhhhh!

Victoire Pisa and the others throwing themselves earnestly into training.
—To understand, we must go back a few days.

The day after she stood up and vowed to weave the circle once more.
Transcend called out to the other Umamusume and the staff, holding an emergency meeting.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bring this up out of nowhere.
I just... couldn't stop thinking about it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Like, maybe this isn't the time
to be running races.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we should head back home right away
and, like... do something about it...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I was just thinking the same thing.
As Umamusume, there should be plenty we can do."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: When I think about the situation in the disaster areas...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
…………
...I want to see everyone's faces. I want to make sure.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My family, my friends,
Air Groove-san... and my teacher, too...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...
I was so happy when I got the invitation to Dubai.
But right now...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Even if I run... it's not like it'll make anyone happy. That's just how I feel. No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text: We were hesitating as well, so if that is what everyone decides—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I—
We should run in the race."

A pin-drop silence fell over the racetrack.
Yet she continued, undeterred.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because it's a time like this,
I believe we ought to run in the race."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Still, Pisa-san—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand.
Right now, there must be many people who are in no position to worry about races."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —I heard that back in Japan, quite a few race meets themselves have been cancelled. ...No, not just the races.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Concerts, flower viewing, ceremonies...
Even school celebration ceremonies
are in a situation where they must be canceled or scaled back.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...My heart aches when I think about the situation in the disaster areas.
I can't just stand by and do nothing—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Still, even if we were to return to Japan in its current state of chaos,
there's probably... very little we could actually do.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: “Yet, if it's in this place, there is something I can do. That is—”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: A victory at the highest peak in Dubai. It is a historic first for a Japanese Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...No way. But, wait, if I win—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am sure it will become
a ray of light piercing through the despair.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There must be people out there who believe in miracles,
stand back up, and learn to join hands with others...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We will win. Not 'if we can,'
but for certain—one of us, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Our team is one. Through victory,
let us unite Japan once more...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...P-Please...
take this.
"It's a charm shaped into a loop of ribbons and pearls—"
She handed those charms to all the Umamusume and staff members.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Did... Pisa-chan make this?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon my presumption.
I made this while offering a prayer.
I hope it can serve as a protective charm for you."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even if we cannot do it alone, if we all combine our strength, I am certain we can accomplish it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That a victory grasped in such a way bridges hearts,
kindling a light of hope in someone's soul—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I believe in it.

Victoire Pisa's powerful words echoed
across the wind-swept grounds.

A charm held in someone's hand
made a soft sound as the wind whipped past.
And—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...――
Yeah, that's true."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The best thing we can do right now
is win. Right?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry.
...Ngh, me too...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best...!
If it's for everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I—no, we would like to as well.
As members of the team,
please let us aim for victory together...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Through victory, hope to Japan.
Even if it's small... a definitive light!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us unite as one—
As Team Japan!
And run like the wind!
And—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*!
Ah... there's still room for improvement...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: “Still, nice fight! It feels like you've really gotten used to the environment!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I can't afford to fall behind either...!

United as one, our days of charging forward
toward victory began!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Here is the analyzed data from the video
of today's tandem training session
that you requested.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"You work so fast!
Thank you very much!"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Also, tonight is the soba and grilled fish you requested.
Look forward to it~!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My...
How lovely, it has been quite a while since I last had Japanese cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Keeping your motivation up is part of my job too.
Feel free to ask for whatever snacks you like!

text_block_list.name: Local Staff A
text_block_list.text:
""These are refreshments for you.
For the team all the way from Japan—please, help yourselves.""

text_block_list.name: Local Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is worried about Japan.
That's precisely why they are praying for all of your victories."

text_block_list.name: Local Staff B
text_block_list.text:
"If I had to choose someone other than an Umamusume from my own country,
I'd definitely want a Japanese Umamusume to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The track conditions are pretty unusual this time.
I ran a few simulations with that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This one is our 2,000m,
and this one is Ruler-chan's 2,410m, right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged. ...As expected, pace-chasers have the advantage in all of them.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text:
This charm... is for us as well?
Are you quite sure?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I want you to fight alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text:
That is—yes. Yes...!
Of course!

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text:
Let's deliver an extraordinary race back home to Japan—
one that will go down in Japanese racing history!

Before long—along with a sandstorm,
that day finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Rulership sinks to 6th place...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Sixth place... dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Why did it have to be now...?! After all that momentum!?
No way, ugh, I hate this, I just wanna go home and sleep—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Is where we're at, but.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Hang in there, Pisa...!
I'll be watching over you till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
I will race to the very end, carrying your feelings with me!"
...And then.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"This year, Japan is fielding three contenders, spearheaded by the queen Buena Vista.
It is truly the strongest possible lineup—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
—With Ruler-chan falling behind too,
I wonder how far she can fight under these conditions...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's not it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do it. I have to do it.
Right, Pisa-chan?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To create inspiration and hope through racing.
To connect people and bring them together in harmony.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: This is... my everything.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of this unprecedented situation,
where people's hearts ache and wear down day by day—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"If I cannot birth even a single sliver of hope,
then what meaning is there to my existence?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We must achieve it.
Our victory, that is.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And... hope.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Even if it costs me my life...!

In the distance, I can hear the commotion.
It was the clamor of a foreign land, a blend of countless languages.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Right now, there is only one thought in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"We want to light the flame of hope in Japan.
Now, do your best, Team Japan!"

"The night deepens.
The race begins—"
